title: Set the page title from any component

slides.say: In React 19 you can set the page title right inside the component that knows it.
Render a title tag anywhere in your tree. React moves its DOM element into the document head for you.
One catch. The title's children must be a single string. Text plus curly braces makes two children, and that's an error. Use a template literal instead.

slides.text: Render only one <title> at a time. Inside an <svg>, <title> is not moved: it labels the graphic.
slides.say: Render only one title at a time, or browsers may pick any of them. And inside an S V G, a title stays put. There it describes the graphic.
